# Webui proxy
This is a webhook endpoint component that:
* serves static files of `webui` package generated by `trunk dist`
* forwards `/api` requests to the Obelisk REST API at `TARGET_URL` so browser requests stay on the WebUI origin.

## Running in obelisk
The component is automatically loaded when `obelisk.toml` contains:
```toml
webui.listening_addr = "127.0.0.1:8080"
```
However, this loads the webui as specified in [webui-version.txt](../../assets/webui-version.txt).
A debug build of `obelisk` loads a local build instead when `OBELISK_WEBUI_WASM` points to it:
```sh
just build
OBELISK_WEBUI_WASM=$PWD/target/wasm32-wasip2/release/webui_proxy.wasm obelisk server run
```

Build
```sh
trunk --log=debug --offline build --config crates/webui/Trunk.toml
cargo build --package webui-proxy --target=wasm32-wasip2 --release
```

Add the `webui-proxy` as a webhook endpoint:
```toml
[[http_server]]
name = "webui2"
listening_addr = "127.0.0.1:8082"

[[webhook_endpoint]]
name = "webui2"
http_server = "webui2"
location.path = "target/wasm32-wasip2/release/webui_proxy.wasm"
routes = [""]
env_vars = ["TARGET_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5005"]
forward_stdout = "stderr"
forward_stderr = "stderr"
```
